name: Bynet TLV A
notes: Official Bynet site lists TLV A at 75 racks, 0.5MW; underground protected server farm in Tel Aviv area.

name: Bynet TLV B
notes: Official Bynet site lists TLV B at 76 racks, 0.5MW; underground protected server farm.

name: Serverfarm ISR1 North Tel Aviv
notes: Serverfarm official page: ISR1 is its first Middle East data center marketed as North Tel Aviv; directories place it at Herzliya (Ha-Sadna'ot St 8, datacenterHawk) or Bnei Zion/Hof HaSharon (DataCenterMap) - physical address not confirmed on official page; capacity not stated officially.

name: Serverfarm ISR3
notes: ISR3 announced Dec 2021: 100,000 sq ft (9,300 sqm), 9MW (press release) / up to 10MW (website), four data halls, 'central Israel near Tel Aviv'; 2026 operating status not verified in this pass.

name: AWS Israel (Tel Aviv) Region il-central-1
notes: AWS Israel (Tel Aviv) Region open Aug 2023 with three Availability Zones, API name il-central-1; logical region only - physical AZ sites/capacity not public (OSINT dossier claims Truvot/Shoham/Beit Shemesh AZ siting, unverified, C-grade).

name: Google Cloud Israel Region me-west1
notes: Google Cloud region me-west1 in Tel Aviv opened 19 Oct 2022 under Project Nimbus context; logical region only, exact datacenter sites not public.

name: Microsoft Azure Israel Central Region
notes: Azure region 'Israel Central' (israelcentral) live; announced 2020 as first Israel cloud datacenter region; logical region only, facility sites/capacity not public.

name: MedOne Tel Aviv / Petah Tikva legacy facilities
notes: Calcalist: MedOne operates four existing facilities including Tel Aviv and Petah Tikva, plus Tirat HaCarmel campus; legacy colocation footprint, capacities not itemized publicly.

name: GTR IS One Petah Tikva
notes: Official GTR location page: 10.5MW secure underground build-to-suit in Petah Tikva, hyperscale spec, PUE<1.17, due operational Spring 2023; 4,800 sqm technical space over two subterranean floors per DCD.

name: NED Alpha Campus Netanya
developer: NED Data Centers; Levinstein Group; Goldacre
notes: Construction begun on 35,000 sqm 42MW AI-ready underground campus in Netanya (Project ALPHA), NIS 1.3B investment; official NED project page: first phase 16 of 60 MVA; first facility expected early 2027 per Globes. 2026 electricity freeze context applies to later phases.

name: MedOne Kfar Yona Campus
notes: Two underground data centers at Kfar Yona, ~30,000 sqm over three underground floors; first facility opens Q4 2026, second 2027; 21MW IT on owned land with first-phase power secured per official expansion page (KY2 directory figure 16MW).

name: MedOne Ramle Campus
notes: Official expansion plan lists Ramle 31.5MW IT across three facilities; DCD notes a 10.5MW Ramla site under construction; underground colocation campus.

name: Bynet Lod Data Center
notes: Official Bynet site lists LOD at 120 racks, 1MW, 500 sqm, Tier 3; underground facility.

name: Bynet Ha'horesh Shoham Data Center
notes: Official Bynet site lists Ha'horesh at 1,690 racks, 20MW, 20,000 sqm, Tier 4; located in Shoham.

name: Mega DC MDCIL-1 Modi'in
notes: Official Mega DC site: MDCIL-1 Modi'in 20MW total, 15K sqm, Tier 3, onsite substation, liquid cooling support; 10MW under construction with RFS 2026 (site marks RFS column 'Operational').

name: Mega DC MDCIL-4 Beit Shemesh Campus
notes: Official Mega DC site: MDCIL-4 Beit Shemesh campus 240MW total, 115K sqm, Tier 3/4, onsite substation, liquid cooling; 120MW under construction with RFS of 60MW in 2027. Also part of Nebius 80MW lease (Masmiyya + Beit Shemesh, Globes 1001531296, Jan 2026).

name: Digital Realty Mivne Petah Tikva Campus
notes: Digital Realty-Mivne JV (2022) to develop multi-tenant campus in Petah Tikva, up to 20MW IT, first phase planned 2023; 2026 operating status not verified - treat as lead pending Mavat/TASE confirmation (methodology flags this for verification).

name: Mega Or / Nebius Modi'in AI Data Center
notes: Jerusalem Post: Mega Or and Nebius launched an AI data center in Modi'in with 8MW electrical power and 4,000 Nvidia GPUs; 25% allocated to Israel Innovation Authority national supercomputer. Separate Jan 2026 Globes report: Nebius 80MW lease across Masmiyya and Beit Shemesh facilities.

name: Techtonic Bet Shemesh Underground Data Center
notes: DCD: Techtonic planning 16MW fortified underground hosting facility in Bet Shemesh, ~20km east of Jerusalem; announced early 2024, status to verify locally (Bet Shemesh assigned to HaMerkaz per repo convention for Mega DC MDCIL-4).

name: Bynet Jerusalem of Gold
notes: Official Bynet site lists Jerusalem of Gold at 1,650 racks, 8MW, 14,000 sqm, Tier 3; Har Hotzvim area.

name: Bynet Jerusalem of Silver
notes: Official Bynet site lists Jerusalem of Silver at 320 racks, 1MW, 1,400 sqm, Tier 3.

name: Bynet Jerusalem of Light
notes: Official Bynet site lists Jerusalem of Light at 450 racks, 3MW, 1,500 sqm, Tier 3.

name: Oracle Israel Cloud Region - Jerusalem Underground Data Center
notes: Oracle Israel cloud region launched Oct 2021 from 14,000 sqm (460,000 sq ft) underground bunker in Jerusalem (Har Hotzvim) constructed by Bynet; first global provider cloud region in Israel; A-grade for region existence, B for facility specifics.

name: MedOne Tirat HaCarmel Campus
notes: MedOne flagship underground enterprise campus at Carmelim St 4, Tirat Carmel (TC1 built 1999, TC3/TC4 phases); AWS Direct Connect on site; capacity not published per facility.

name: MedOne Tirat HaCarmel Expansion
notes: Official MedOne expansion roadmap: negotiating adjacent land at Tirat HaCarmel with path to incremental 21MW IT across two additional facilities; subject to 2026 Electricity Authority freeze for 8MVA+ connections.

name: Mega DC MDCIL-3 MATAM Haifa
notes: Official Mega DC site: MDCIL-3 MATAM Haifa 20MW, 14K sqm, Tier 3/4, onsite substation; 20MW under construction with RFS of 10MW in 2027; within MATAM Haifa High-Tech Park, 500m from subsea cable landing.

name: Mega Or / Mega DC MDCIL-8 Hadera Campus (ex-Alliance Tire site)
notes: Mega Or bought former Alliance Tire factory site in Hadera (180 dunam, NIS 1B cash, Apr 2026) to build one of Israel's largest data centers; official Mega DC site lists MDCIL-8 Hadera Campus, 180K sqm, power TBD, 1km from 2.6GW Orot Rabin power plant and 0.3km from an 800MW private plant; planned/speculative until planning and power documents.

name: Nvidia Yokneam Israel-1 AI/HPC Data Center
notes: Nvidia operates AI/HPC data center infrastructure in Yokneam (Israel-1 supercomputer, ~30MW R&D facility per trade reporting; DCD references an unnamed 30MW facility leased by Nvidia in Yokne'am); capacity not officially published.

name: Nvidia / Mega DC Mevo Carmel AI Campus
notes: ~64MW AI campus in Mevo Carmel Science & Industry Park near Yokneam; dcpulse lists status 'Construction' with Mega Or DC as lead developer, high-density liquid cooling for Blackwell processors; Globes Dec 2025 reported talks for 64MW build; power/planning evidence still needed under 2026 freeze.

name: Anan Data Center Afula (Crusoe anchor lease)
developer: Anan Data Centers (Omer Adam et al.); tenant: Crusoe
notes: Anan Afula (Jezreel Valley) AI-ready underground data center under construction; Crusoe leased 40MW anchor capacity (~$1B deal, Apr 2026), up to ~100MW full build-out; official Anan site confirms AI-ready high-density facilities; Afula assigned to HaTsafon district.

name: Bynet 'Northern' Green Site
notes: Official Bynet site lists a 'Northern' greenfield site at 64MW, energy-storage based; exact location in northern Israel not public; planned status.

name: Dalia Ofek Data Center (near Ashdod)
developer: Dalia Energy; Serverfarm; Israel Infrastructure Fund (IIF)
notes: Ofek: 130MW AI data center (scalable to 200MW) near Ashdod, $1.5B construction investment (up to $5B with full AI GPU deployment), direct power from planned 850MW plant; completion targeted H2 2029 per DataCenterMap; Dalia also plans Ashdod-Europe submarine cable; 2026 Electricity Authority freeze (8MVA+/50MVA hearings) means power/planning status not fully validated - remains planned.

name: Mega DC MDCIL-2 Masmia
notes: Official Mega DC site: MDCIL-2 Masmia 40MW, 20K sqm, Tier 3, onsite substation, liquid cooling, RFS 2026; AI-ready up to 1MW/rack; Masmia industrial zone south of Tel Aviv; Nebius 80MW lease covers Masmiyya + Beit Shemesh (Jan 2026).

name: Mega DC MDCIL-5 Idan HaNegev Campus
notes: Official Mega DC site: MDCIL-5 Idan HaNegev campus 180MW total, 75K sqm, Tier 3/4, onsite substation, liquid cooling, RFS 2028; 60MW under construction with RFS 2027.

name: Mega DC MDCIL-6 Masmia (502)
notes: Official Mega DC site lists MDCIL-6 Masmia (502), 46K sqm, Tier 3/4, onsite substation, liquid cooling; total power TBD; planned.

name: Mega DC MDCIL-7 Masmia (201)
notes: Official Mega DC site lists MDCIL-7 Masmia (201), 20K sqm, Tier 3/4, onsite substation, liquid cooling; total power TBD; planned.

name: Keystone / IPM Be'er Tuvia Two-Data-Center Campus
notes: Application registered with Be'er Tuvia local planning committee (Jan 2025) for two data centers totaling 40MW IT (~15,000 sqm above/below ground) inside the 451MW IPM gas power plant; ~$388M; possible completion 2027 if approved; approval/power status pending - planned.

name: MedOne Dimona Campus
notes: Aggregator-listed underground campus in Dimona Industrial Area (DM1/DM2; DataCenterMap lists ~30MW/15,000kW critical power, 64,583 sq ft); no official MedOne page with Dimona capacity/status - C-grade lead; MedOne roadmap includes southern expansion.

name: Bynet Beit Nir Green Site
notes: Official Bynet site lists 'Beit Nir' at 64MW, green site, energy-storage based; Beit Nir kibbutz in Southern District; planned status, power connection subject to 2026 electricity freeze.

name: Bynet Magen Green Site
notes: Official Bynet site lists 'Magen' at 64MW, green site, energy-storage based; Magen kibbutz near Gaza border (Southern District); planned status, power connection subject to 2026 electricity freeze.
